what_happened: In job hg0n (a code job), the user corrected Athena's first reading before work began. The reading was for the replay check on refusal rules. The user made three changes. (1) The replay result must be stored as a typed record that the records check accepts, either a new record kind with a schema round-trip test or a field on an existing verification record. The reading had planned a free-form replay.md. (2) The test override must go in front of tree resolution and the subcommand probe. (3) The no-model-call property must be checked by comparing model call counts with and without a candidate change. The reading had needed a skip switch.
cause: The reading stage designs storage, override and test details from a general idea of the feature. It does not look at what the records check accepts, where resolution and probing happen in the code, or how to measure a property directly. Free-form files are the easiest place for output, and a skip switch is the easiest way to prove no model call. Neither is checked against the repo before the reading is accepted. The closely related earlier case (cmb6) was the same job family, but its correction covered only how to detect changes, not where results are stored or how tests are wired. So the user's design knowledge was not carried over.
prevention: Add a reading-stage check that runs before the reading is accepted. Any reading that writes a new output must name a file or record kind already in the records validation allow-list, or must list a typed record with a schema round-trip test as a deliverable. Any reading that adds a test override must name the earliest code point it has to apply at. Any reading that claims a property such as "no model call" must state a directly measurable check, like comparing call counts, not a new switch added just for the test. Give the reading stage the records allow-list and a short rule list for these three points.
proposed_request: Revise the reading for the replay check job so that: (1) the replay result is stored as a typed record accepted by the records check, either a new record kind with a schema round-trip test or a new field on an existing verification record, and not as a free-form replay.md; (2) the test override that selects the base and candidate builds applies before tree resolution and the subcommand probe; (3) the no-model-call property is shown by a test that compares model call counts with and without a candidate change, with no skip switch added. Keep every other criterion from the earlier reading. Each criterion must name evidence the verifier can observe itself.
